description: Go back one screen. The result starts with 'Change: none | content changed | new screen | scrolled'.

compact.description: When the change is 'content changed', return only the added/removed lines, not the whole screen

settle.description: Wait until the screen stops changing (two equal reads 100 ms apart), up to timeout_ms. Use after any action that starts work. A slow result can still follow a pause, so prefer wait_for when you know the expected text.

timeout_ms.description: How long wait_for and settle may take, in ms (default 2000)

wait_for.description: Use after any action that starts work. Wait until this appears (a ref, a text, or role+name), or disappears with gone: true. The result says Waited: matched or timed out.

name: back
